summary: Sandbach United had a tough pre-season match against St Helens, who were clinical in front of goal in what was otherwise an evenly contested game. With just one week until the 26/27 season kicks off, the Ramblers are gearing up with three brand new kits and some exciting new signings plus a returning player to bolster the squad. The club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities, so get in touch if you're interested in supporting the team's promotion push this season!
